classes.name: Sumika
classes.description: The habitat: a local daemon and CLI that own interactive PTY sessions so they outlive the terminal window. The daemon writes one operator log without PTY contents. The terminal is a client, not the process owner.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A named child process {name, argv, cwd} living in a PTY owned by Sumika. Uniqueness is name. cwd is the child's working directory, not a project or picker filter. The daemon keeps a last VT frame and a bounded line ring for attach. Not a pane, tab, kind, or headless run.

classes.name: ConfiguredSession
classes.description: A start recipe {name, argv, cwd?, key?} in the operator config. Not a live Session until start. Not a kind or pane.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: The operator file that lists ConfiguredSession records. Path precedence: --config, then SUMIKA_CONFIG, then ~/.config/sumika/config.toml.

classes.name: Attach
classes.description: The exclusive focused client of one Session. Bytes are a raw PTY. A second Attach steals. Detach leaves the child.

classes.name: Picker
classes.description: The full-screen list used to jump between Sessions by name. Not a layout, sidebar, multiplexer, or directory scope.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: A hook-originated attention signal for a Session: idle, blocked, or running. Absence is unknown. Not a screen scrape.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: A vendor hook snippet that emits a Report from a Stop or permission event. It merges into existing settings. It does not parse the PTY. A broken payload does not kill the child.

classes.name: CopyMode
classes.description: A client overlay over a Session's bounded line ring. Yank copies a line to the system clipboard. Attach is a raw PTY when CopyMode is off. Not a pane, not a screen scrape, not an agent TUI.

classes.name: ResumeHint
classes.description: Optional opaque vendor chat identity stored on a Session only when a confirmed Stop payload provides an id and a confirmed resume-by-id flag exists. Not a Session. Sumika never invents it.

relations.name: runs_in
relations.description: A Session lives in Sumika. Sumika owns the process; the terminal does not.

relations.name: focuses
relations.description: An Attach is the exclusive focused client of one Session. A new Attach steals.

relations.name: jumps_to
relations.description: A Picker jumps to a Session by selecting it and attaching. q leaves the Picker; children stay.

relations.name: updates
relations.description: A Report updates a Session's attention status. It does not parse the PTY.

relations.name: emits
relations.description: An Adapter emits a Report for a Session named by SUMIKA_SESSION. Unknown events emit nothing.

relations.name: lists
relations.description: A Config lists ConfiguredSession recipes. Starting one creates a Session of the same name; it does not keep a second child for a live name.

relations.name: starts_as
relations.description: A ConfiguredSession starts as a Session of the same name. The daemon owns the process; the config is a client-side recipe.

relations.name: inspects
relations.description: CopyMode inspects a Session's line ring. It does not parse the PTY or share attach.

relations.name: optionally_stores
relations.description: A Session may store one ResumeHint. The hint is not the Session. Absence means restart argv only.
